rewrites.comment: Savewise is a single-page app: the server has one HTML file and React Router resolves the path in the browser. Without this, a hard refresh on /dashboard — or anyone opening a shared link — asks Vercel for a file that does not exist and gets a 404. Assets are served before rewrites, so /assets/* is unaffected.

headers.comment: Hashed filenames are immutable, so they can be cached forever.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy leaves visitors on a stale bundle that references deleted asset hashes.
The API sets its own headers; these protect the static site.
